defects.title: Dashboard recent-spend summary still uses REST payment history instead of encrypted browser transport
defects.suspected_root_cause: The dashboard cost-summary loader still calls `api.getPaymentHistory(...)` per worker and the e2e harness still mocks `**/api/v1/payments/history**` as the canonical source for Recent Spend.
defects.recommended_fix: Route dashboard payment-summary reads through an approved encrypted browser transport path and replace REST payment-history mocks with deterministic encrypted request/result fixtures.

defects.title: Settings relay visibility still depends on raw system discovery relays instead of service-authored NIP-51 relay-list data
defects.suspected_root_cause: The settings page still renders `systemInfo.nostr.relays` directly and no relay-list event subscription path has been implemented for operator-facing server relay visibility.
defects.recommended_fix: Implement operator relay visibility from a service-authored kind 30002 relay-list event and remove the settings-page dependency on raw `systemInfo.nostr.relays` for approved behavior.
